title: Halka açılmadan önce aile tezgahı, çöküşte milyarlık soygun: Tera Portföy'ün 'yönetim ücreti' çarkı
content:
Andaç Aydın Arıduru [email protected]

Borsa İstanbul'da patlak veren fon temerrüt krizinin merkezindeki portföylerden Tera Portföy'ün "TLY" kodlu serbest fonuna ilişkin yürütülen soruşturmada, fonun halka arz edilmeden önce şirket ve Emre Tezmen'in aile üyeleri tarafından kapalı devre olarak kurulduğu ortaya çıktı. Mali Suçları Araştırma Kurulu (MASAK) raporları, fonun yüzde 99,38'inin Tera şirketlerine ait olduğunu ve ilk yatırımcılar arasında tutuklanan Tezmen'in çocuklarının bulunduğunu kayıtlara geçirirken, şirketin resmi finansal raporları ise suni hacimle birlikte portföy yönetim ücretlerinden elde edilen devasa geliri belgeledi. Şirketin Nisan 2025'te aylık 26 milyon lira seviyesinde olan fon yönetim ücreti kesintisinin, 2026 yaz aylarında aylık 405 milyon liraya fırlaması, fona katılarak para yatıran yurttaşlardan toplanan paranın yönetim gideri adı altında şirkete nasıl aktarıldığını gözler önüne serdi.

MASAK, TLY kodlu Tera Portföy Birinci Serbest Fonu'nun Türkiye Elektronik Fon Alım Satım Platformu’na (TEFAS) açılmasından önceki başlangıç dönemindeki yatırımcı yapısını inceledi. Rapordaki verilere göre fonun en büyük yatırımcısı yüzde 76,20'lik pay ve 9 milyon 598 bin 197 adet bakiye ile Tera Yatırım Menkul Değerler A.Ş. oldu. İkinci büyük ortak olan Tera Portföy Yönetimi A.Ş. ise yüzde 23,18 pay ve 2 milyon 920 bin 391 bakiye ile fonda yer aldı. Böylece doğrudan iki Tera şirketinin fondaki toplam payının yüzde 99,38’e ulaştığı tespit edildi.

Rapor verileri, fonun ilk yatırımcıları arasında Tera şirketlerinin yanı sıra 9 gerçek kişinin bulunduğunu ve bu isimler arasında tutuklanan Emre Tezmen’in çocukları Dilara Tezmen ve Sinan Tezmen'in de yer aldığını gösterdi. MASAK raporunda, Dilara Tezmen’in fonda yüzde 0,14 pay karşılığında 17 bin 80, Sinan Tezmen’in ise yüzde 0,07 pay karşılığında 8 bin 540 bakiyesinin bulunduğu kaydedildi. Fonun ilk dönemindeki diğer yatırımcıların pay oranları ise; Ali Yürüdü yüzde 0,04, İhsan Çimen yüzde 0,15, Türker Vancı yüzde 0,04, Uğur Sungar yüzde 0,05 ve Ümit Aydın yüzde 0,12 olarak rapora yansıdı. Akif Dağdelen ve Ethem Umut Beytorun'un ise yüzde 0,00 ile listede yer aldı.

TEFAS öncesi kendi içlerinde alım-satım yaparak şişirilen sığ hisselerin değerini artıran fonun, halka açıldıktan sonra bireysel yatırımcılardan topladığı milyarlarca lira üzerinden Tera Portföy'e aktardığı yönetim ücretleri resmi raporlarla netleşti. Fonun resmi finansal tablolarına göre, şirketin kâğıt üzerinde yarattığı hacim büyüdükçe yatırımcının parasından kestiği yönetim komisyonu devasa boyutlara ulaştı Fon bilgilerinin ilk kez KAP’a bildirildiği Nisan 2025 döneminde TLY fonunun net varlık değeri 18 milyar 233 milyon lira iken, şirketin ay içinde kestiği fon yönetim ücreti 26 milyon 355 bin 628 lira olarak gerçekleşti.

Fonun halka açılarak yatırımcı toplamasının ardından Nisan 2026 itibarıyla net varlık değeri 125 milyar 664 milyon liraya fırlarken, Tera Portföy'ün aylık fon yönetim ücreti tahsilatı 208 milyon 597 bin 807 liraya çıktı. Krizin hemen öncesindeki Temmuz 2026 raporunda, fon büyüklüğü 222 milyar 116 milyon lira olarak kayıtlara geçerken, şirketin yatırımcıların parasından kestiği aylık yönetim ücreti Nisan 2025'e göre 15 kattan fazla (yüzde 1439 oranında) artarak tam 405 milyon 717 bin 512 liraya ulaştı. Ağustos 2026 dönemine ait faaliyet raporunda ise fon hacmi 247 milyar 632 milyon lira olarak görünürken, şirketin bu kez aylık değil sadece bir haftalık periyotta kestiği fon yönetim ücretinin 96 milyon 538 bin 128 lira oldu.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Haydarpaşa’nın Son Memuru üzerine: "Kurmaca, hakikatten kötü oldu"
content:
Haydarpaşa Garı | Fotoğraf: Hasan Can Bilici/Evrensel

Haydarpaşa Garı, yalnızca taş duvarlardan, raylardan ya da tarihi bir mimariden ibaret değil, İstanbullu emekçilerin hafızasında derin izler bırakmış bir simge. Yıllardır var olan kentsel dönüşüm tartışmaları, restorasyon süreçleri ve ana işlevinden uzaklaştırılma çabalarıyla gündemden düşmeyen Haydarpaşa Garı’nın, son olarak önümüzdeki günlerde başlayacak İstanbul Kültür Yolu Festivali kapsamında kapılarını açması bekleniyordu. Yapılan son dakika açıklamalarıyla garın açılışı 2027 yılına ertelendi.

Bu mekansal ve kültürel dönüşüm halini, TCDD bürokrasisine adım atan genç bir avukatın gözünden mercek altına alan Başar Öztürk’ün Haydarpaşa’nın Son Memuru romanı, tam da bu tasfiye hikayesini ve kurumun “çözülüşünü” edebi bir zemine taşıyor. Yazar Başar Öztürk’le Haydarpaşa’nın geçmişten bugüne evrilen hikayesini konuştuk.

Haydarpaşa’nın Son Memuru, TCDD bürokrasisi içine giren genç bir avukatın gözünden hem bireysel bir hikayeyi hem de bir kurumun ve garın çözülüşünü anlatıyor. Bir hukukçu ve yazar olarak Haydarpaşa Garı’nı ve onun son dönemini anlatan bir roman yazma fikri nasıl ortaya çıktı? Neden odak noktası olarak Haydarpaşa’yı ve bir demiryolu memurunu seçtiniz?

Yazmaya başlayacağım zamanlarda bir tasfiye hikayesi anlatmak istiyordum. Hayallerimde, yaşadığım ülkede, inandıklarımda bir tasfiye ve çözülme hali söz konusuydu. Bu duyguyu yoğun yaşadığım için bunun yazma sürecinde beni motive edeceğine inanıyordum öyle de oldu. Tasfiye derken sadece mekânsal değil, zamansal ve uzamsal da bir tasfiyeden bahsediyorum, bir sökülüş.

Tasfiye, ray üzerindeki bir tren gibi kaçınılmaz olarak ilerler, sağa sola sapma iradesi olmadan neredeyse kaderci bir ilerleyiştedir. Onu güçlü ve dramatik anlatıma elverişli kılan da bu sanırım. Sonun hemen değil de yavaş yavaş ama engellenemez şekilde her hücrenize sine sine her hücrenizi çürüte çürüte gelmesi… Yazarken aradığım bu tasfiye iklimine Haydarpaşa çok iyi uyuyordu. Hikayeyi de daha sahici kılıyordu. Ben de elimden geldiğince, bu harika mekânın tasfiyesini bir insan ve zaman tasfiyesiyle birleştirmeye çalıştım. Karakteri burada çalışan biri yapmak, aslında anlatıcı açısından kaçınılmazdı. Onun gar binasıyla paralel şekilde çözülmesini istiyordum.

Romanda garın çatı katındaki yanık ve is kokusu, geçmişe ait değerlerin ve bir dönemin kaybı olarak tarif ediliyor. Karakteriniz Efes ihaleyi iptal ederek süreci durdursa da bu durum genel gidişatı ve yıkımı engelleyemiyor. Bireysel veya bürokratik hamlelerin böylesi büyük kentsel dönüşüm kararları karşısındaki etkisini nasıl değerlendiriyorsunuz?

Efes, bireycilikle nihilizm arasında sallanan bir karakter. Özellikle babasının sosyalist görüşlü bir idealist olmasının, ailede geçim sıkıntısına ve sürgünlere yol açmasından çok etkilenmiş. Ama bu öyle bir şey ki, bir sorun orada durmaya devam ediyor. Bireyci olmanız, nihilist olmanız, o sorunu da o sorunun size tesir etmesini de engellemiyor. Rakibin sizden güçlü olması, sizi yenebilecek kudrette olması, savunduğunuz şeyin önemini de zaruriliğini de değiştirmiyor. Evet, yenmek için mücadele harika olurdu ya da mücadelenin sonunda kazanacağınızın garantisinin size verilmesi, ama doğrunun yanında kalabilmek de yenileceğini bilerek mücadele etmek de daha az kıymetli değil. Aslında Efes, benim de mücadeleler konusunda bir özeleştirim de diyebilirim. Teşhisler, “farkındalıklar”, çıkarımlar, “iyi insan”, “duyarlı insan” olmalar… Bunların ufacık bir eylemin karşısında tüy kadar değeri yok sanırım. Asıl olan bu çağda bile eylem.

Kitapta sadece ana gar binası değil, arkasındaki lojmanlar, orada yaşayan personelin hayatı ve komşuluk ilişkileri de geniş yer tutuyor. Haydarpaşa’yı sadece bir bina olarak değil, çevresindeki lojman ve çalışanlarıyla birlikte ele almanızın sebebi neydi?

Tabii, burada çalışan demiryolcu emekçilerin hepsi bir kadrodan ibaret değildi. Memur maaşıyla oturmanın neredeyse imkânsız olduğu, daha çok varsılların yaşayabildiği mahallelerde lojmanlar vasıtasıyla oturma imkânı tanınmıştı onlara. O lojmanlarda aileler vardı, çocuklar vardı. İlk aşklar, küskünlükler, komşu kavgaları, kıskançlıkları, hep birlikte lojman avlusunda yapılan sohbetler vardı. Balyozunuzu gara vurduğunuzda bu hayatlara moloz parçalarının sıçramaması mümkün değildi.

Tüm bu duygularla demiryolu çalışanlarının romanda yer almalarını istedim. Belgesel nitelikte olmasa da anlatının sahiciliği açısından bunun şüphesiz benim yararıma olduğunu …

author: Unknown
title: Belki ‘oradan’ bir çıkış yolu buluruz diye düşündüm
content:
Ekran görüntüsü BOSCH Global isimli Youtube kanalında yayınlanan tanıtım videosundan alınmştır.

Geçtiğimiz aylarda borsada yatırım yapmıştım, ama yaşanan vurgunla birlikte birikimimin büyük kısmını kaybettim. Zaten ucu ucuna yaşamaya çalışıyorduk. Bir umutla yatırım yapmıştım, belki biraz nefes alırız yarın bir gün işten çıkarılırsak tazminat dışında cebimde bir şey olsun diye. Ama paramız battı. Şimdi hem fabrikada işten atılma korkusu var hem de ekonomik olarak daha da sıkıştım.

Fabrikada aldığımız ücretle bir gelecek kurmak imkânsız hale geldi. Çocuk okutmak, ev geçindirmek, birikim yapmak… Bunların hiçbiri mümkün değil. Bankaya koysan faiz yetmiyor, enflasyon karşısında eriyor. O yüzden birçok işçi gibi ben de borsaya yöneldim. Belki oradan bir çıkış yolu buluruz diye düşündüm.

Büyük bir güvensizlik. Hem fabrikada işten atılma korkusu var hem de ekonomik olarak hiçbir güvence yok. İnsanlar bir umutla borsaya giriyor ama sonuçta yine kaybeden işçi oluyor. Çünkü bireysel çıkış yolları hep tıkanıyor. İki üç kişi kazanıyor yaygara bir kopuyor herkes hurra borsaya, kumara bitcoinde de yaşadık aynılarını.

Aslında bir çaresizlikten doğan alternatif. Bosch gibi dev şirketin kârını biz yaratıyoruz. Ama o kâr bize dönmüyor. Patronlar borsada servetlerine servet katarken, biz küçük yatırımcı olarak elimizdeki üç beş kuruşu da kaybediyoruz. Bu da ayrı bir adaletsizlik.

Ağustosa kadar yüzlerce arkadaşımız işten çıkarıldı. Resmi gerekçeler hep “verimlilik” ya da “küçülme” oluyor ama biz biliyoruz ki patronlar kârlarını korumak için işçileri gözden çıkarıyor. İnsanlar yıllarca emek veriyor, bir günde kapının önüne konuluyor.

Büyük bir öfke var. Çünkü işten atılanların çoğu yıllardır burada çalışan insanlar. Sendika sessiz kalıyor. Hatta insan kaynakları gibi davranıyor. İşten atma olacak diye bütün yöneticiler küheylan kesilmiş tepemizde yanlışımızı arıyor. Kaşının üstünde göz var diye milletle tartışıyorlar. İşler azaldı deniyor biz ek mesailer yapıyoruz sürekli. Dert ücret ortalamasını düşürmek kimse bundan bahsetmiyor. Herkes 90lı yıllarda fabrikaya giren işçilerin ne kadar yüksek maaş aldığını, evini arabasını konuşuyor. Kimse patronun kârını konuşmuyor. Senelerdir bizden elde ettiği kârla ne kadar büyüdüğüne herkes gözlerini kapamış. Herkes birbirine düşüyor, birlikte kazanmak kimsenin aklının ucundan geçmiyor.

İşçilerin birlikte hareket etmesi gerekiyor. Bosch gibi büyük fabrikalarda işten atmalar sadece bizim değil, bütün işçi sınıfının sorunu. Yoksa kumardan, borsadan medet umup batıp batıp başa sarıyoruz. Ömrümüz yarın yaşayacağımız hayatın borcunu ödemekle geçiyor. Üç kuruş para kazanalım diye ceptekinden de oluyoruz. İşten çıkarmalarla hayatımız daha da zorlaşacak.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: The Crisis Isn't What We're Doing | Jason Bayless on Animal Liberation
content:
"The crisis isn't what we're doing. It's what we've all agreed to believe in order to make this normal."


Jason Bayless, founder of A Radical Guide, from Code Red: Cruelty to Animals at Industrial Scale


85 billion land animals are killed for food every year. That's more than ten times the number of people alive. A number like that needs a culture underneath it, one where it seems reasonable for some beings to exist only to be used up.


That logic doesn't stay with animals. Once a society accepts that billions of lives are disposable, it gets easier to say the same about poor people, migrants, communities under occupation, anyone ranked as less valuable.


What would it look like to organize our economies, our food systems, our science and our technologies around the idea that no one is disposable?

author: Rudi Keller
title: Supreme Court Shuts Down Missouri’s Gerrymandered Congressional Map
content:
After weeks of legal battles, Missouri voters will cast November ballots in the districts used in the past two elections.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

The U.S. Supreme Court on Friday drove a stake through the heart of Missouri’s undead congressional map, ordering it be buried for the year and for voters to cast ballots in the districts they’ve used the past two election cycles.

In a unanimous decision, the court said that state law rules in the case.

“In short, as a matter of state law, the 2022 map — not the 2025 map — must be used in the 2026 congressional election,” states the ruling, which is unsigned.

The decision ends, for this election at least, Republicans’ effort to use a gerrymandered map to improve their chances of winning a seventh Missouri seat in the U.S. House.

It also caps three weeks of dramatic court action that changed the map in place for November five times, tested the jurisdiction and overlap of state and federal courts and exasperated local election officials responsible for conducting the vote.

In the final brief filed on behalf of Secretary of State Denny Hoskins before the ruling, state Solicitor General Lou Capozzi said it was already too late to prevent chaos in this year’s election.

“(T)he honest truth is that — regardless of what this court does — Missouri will not be able to run an orderly 2026 general election,” Capozzi wrote. “If required to use the 2025 map, Missouri can maintain the status quo that governed for about a year and will avoid disenfranchising individuals who voted in the primary election; but Missouri will undoubtedly violate (the federal law) deadline for sending ballots to military and overseas voters.”

The gerrymandered map drawn last year by the legislature targeted U.S. Rep. Emanuel Cleaver of Kansas City by stretching the 5th District deep into Republican strongholds in rural counties along the Missouri River. Under the boundaries drawn in 2022, Cleaver won with 60% of the vote in each of the past two elections.

Using the 2022 map means voters in 28 counties will be in different districts in November than they were in the Aug. 4 primary. The changes impact the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 6th districts in addition to reversal of the gerrymander in the 5th District.

In a fundraising appeal sent jointly with 1st District U.S. Rep. Wesley Bell of St. Louis on Friday morning, Cleaver said it was “a never-ending case of ‘Groundhog Day’.”

The decision found that the courts Sept. 10 order directing the use of the 2022 map had been misunderstood by both the 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals and U.S. Chief District Judge Stephen Clark when orders to use the 2025 map were issued.

The order of Sept. 10 “meant that the 2022 map would be used in the 2026 congressional election in Missouri, absent further order of this court,” the opinion states.

The election would be thrown into turmoil if the 2025 map was used, the court stated.

“At this late date, ordering reversion to the 2025 map in the midst of an ongoing election would usher in electoral chaos,” the court stated, citing the brief filed by county clerks and election authorities with the 8th Circuit.

The decision means election officials, who began accepting absentee ballots Tuesday, can continue their preparations without interruption.

In Boone County in central Missouri, some voters in the 3rd and 4th districts would have moved into the 5th District and some from the 4th to the 3rd. County Clerk Brianna Lennon said 16 in-person absentee ballots and one overseas ballot had been cast by Friday morning.

While most are from voters in the 3rd District who would not have changed if the Supreme Court had upheld Clark’s order, five could not wait.

Other voters who have come to the office have decided to wait, she said.

“At least one person didn’t have an option,” Lennon said Wednesday of a voter who cast their ballot on Tuesday, the first day of absentee voting. “They were leaving today.”

In St. Charles County, 410 of the 1,889 absentee ballots sent locally and to overseas voters are in the 2nd District and could not be counted if the districts had changed, county elections Director Kurt Bahr said.

“If the courts change the map we will have to reach out to them and ask if they want a new ballot,” Bahr said.

Friday’s decision was the third time the Supreme Court acted on an emergency appeal …

title: Peshmerga Ministry: International Coalition’s financial assistance has ended
content:
The Secretary-General of the Ministry of Peshmerga in the Kurdistan Region, Lieutenant General Bakhtiar Mohammed Sadiq, confirmed on Saturday that the Global Coalition has halted financial assistance to the Peshmerga forces.


Bakhtiar told the Iraqi News Agency (INA) that the period specified for financial assistance provided by the Global Coalition to the Peshmerga forces had ended in accordance with the prior agreement concluded between the two sides, noting that the financial assistance for August and September 2026 was the final payment under the agreement.


He continued that “the memorandum of understanding was in effect from September 21, 2022, to September 21, 2026, for a period of four years. The memorandum has expired, and thus the transfer of financial amounts by the Global Coalition has also ended.”


He pointed out that “the Ministry of Peshmerga had announced that the financial assistance provided by the Global Coalition for August and September 2026 was distributed last Thursday, September 24, and this was the final payment according to the agreement.”


Bakhtiar confirmed that “we requested the federal government to compensate for this assistance by adjusting the salaries of the Peshmerga forces in line with the Iraqi forces.”

author: Unknown
title: Saturday Mothers demand justice for Ibrahim and Edip Çelik
content:
At their 1,122nd vigil in Istanbul’s Galatasaray Square, the Saturday Mothers commemorated Ibrahim and Edip Çelik. The father and son were abducted and forcibly disappeared by the radical Islamist Hezbollah on July 10, 1994, in the northern Kurdish province of Batman. There has been no sign of them since.


Relatives of the disappeared and numerous human rights activists took part in the vigil. They carried photographs of people who disappeared or were killed in state custody, as well as red carnations. The statement on the case was read by lawyer Jiyan Kaya of the Istanbul branch of the Human Rights Association (IHD).


IHD points to links with the state apparatus


Kaya recalled that the Hezbollah death squads abducted and forcibly disappeared numerous people during the 1990s. She also pointed to the role of state structures, saying there was established evidence that Hezbollah could rely on protection and support from parts of the security and administrative bureaucracy in carrying out these crimes and that its activities were tolerated by the state. As a result, there was no effective state intervention against these crimes.


What happened on July 10, 1994?


On the evening of July 10, 1994, four masked and armed men knocked on the door of the Çelik family home. Under the pretext that they wanted him to show them a location, they took 50-year-old Ibrahim Çelik with them. His son Edip, who was 19 at the time, followed because he did not want to leave his father alone.


When neither of them returned, the family contacted the gendarmerie and police and subsequently filed a criminal complaint with the public prosecutor’s office. According to the IHD, the family identified five Hezbollah members in connection with the abduction: Talat Rüzgar, Aziz Önlük, Ilhan Önlük, Resul Güneş, and Çetin Dursun.


Necessary investigations were not carried out


The family’s efforts produced no results. “The necessary steps to interview witnesses, question suspects, and investigate the case in all its dimensions were not taken,” Kaya said. There was never any further word from Ibrahim and Edip Çelik. The search begun by Ibrahim’s wife, Merese Çelik, is now being continued by their children and grandchildren. “No matter how many years pass, we will not stop demanding justice for Ibrahim and Edip Çelik and for all our disappeared, and reminding the state that it must abide by the rule of law.”


“How many more generations must go through this?”


Berfin Çelik, Ibrahim Çelik’s granddaughter, then spoke. “I am a grandchild of the Saturday Mothers. For three generations, we have stood in Galatasaray Square,” she said. “Having to wonder what happened to them has become a torment for us. How many more generations must go through this? We want to know the truth.”


She said the family would not give up its search: “As the Çelik family, we will continue this struggle.”


At the end of the vigil, the relatives of the disappeared laid their carnations in Galatasaray Square.

author: Qassam Muaddi
title: Israeli Attacks on Water Leave Palestinians in Masafer Yatta Struggling to Survive
content:
Israeli forces and settlers have damaged the area’s main water line five times since January.

Truthout is a vital news source and a living history of political struggle. If you think our work is valuable, support us with a donation of any size.

Palestinians in Masafer Yatta, in the south Hebron hills, are facing repeated water cuts after Israeli settlers damaged infrastructure supplying water to families in the area. According to Hebron’s governor Khaled Dudin, this attack follows a persistent pattern of settlers directly targeting the water supply, now for the fifth time.

Masafer Yatta is a 36-square-kilometer semi-desertic hilly area in the South Hebron region of the occupied West Bank. It directly overlooks the Naqab desert and extends west to the edge of the Dead Sea Valley. The hills are adjacent to the 1949 Armistice line, known today as the Green Line and viewed internationally as the borders of Israel proper. This strategic location makes it crucial for urban and agricultural growth south of the West Bank. For Israel, Masafer Yatta is treated as a buffer zone separating Israel proper from the deeper Palestinian demographic presence — a zone that needs to be emptied of Palestinians.

Last Saturday, during a field visit to Masafer Yatta, governor Dudin told the media that 1,600 Palestinian families within these 14 Palestinian hamlets are facing difficult living conditions due to damaged water lines, with families forced to rely on water tanks. Dudin also pointed out that water lines had been previously rehabilitated with the support of international organizations.

The Israeli settlers’ attacks on Palestinians’ means of life in Masafer Yatta has been ongoing since before October 2023, but has escalated in the past three years, and particularly in the past weeks. Sami Hureini, local activist and resident, told Mondoweiss that “the villages of Masafer Yatta have come under a relentless wave of attacks by settler groups, but also of demolitions by the Israeli army itself.”

Hureini said that there is no real infrastructure for services in Masafer Yatta, because the Israeli army doesn’t allow it. “In the past years, the communities were able to extend one water line from the edge of the zone where the Israeli army imposes strict control, and reached all 14 villages,” Hureini said. “But Israeli settlers kept damaging it, and sometimes the Israeli army bulldozed it.”

The main water line in the area was extended in 2018. It was first cut by the Israeli army’s civil administration in 2019, but was fixed by the joint municipality of Masafer Yatta. It was then partially damaged by Israeli settlers and fixed again multiple times.

In January, the Israeli army cut it again, and since then, it was damaged five times by Israeli settlers or the army.

The demolition of Palestinian property in Masafer Yatta has intensified since 2023, but more particularly since the beginning of 2026.

The area under strict Israeli military control was designated as a “firing zone” (areas in the West Bank that are off-limits to civilians and controlled by the Israeli army) in 1980, and Palestinians are not allowed to build or develop infrastructure around their homes. Palestinian families have been engaged in a legal battle with the Israeli army in Israeli courts for over 20 years for their right to live in their villages. In May 2022, the Israeli court gave its definitive ruling on the case — against the Palestinian residents, hence green-lighting their expulsion. This expulsion, Hureini affirmed, has been happening in a gradual, but accelerating manner since before the ruling.

Two weeks ago, Israeli forces demolished multiple built structures in Fakhit, a hamlet that is home to 70 residents and 12 farming families, leaving 30 people without housing. According to testimonies published by the Arabic news site Alaraby Al-Jadeed, Israeli forces gave residents only 20 minutes to evacuate. In the past two days alone, Israeli forces conducted 24 demolitions in three villages: Fakhit, Tabban, and Jinba, leaving 300 people without homes.

“People did not leave,” Hureini explained.“They stay in tents and caves that they have cleaned and made into living spaces, but living conditions are very dire, and are getting worse every day.”

title: 1er OCT - MARTIGUES - RASSEMBLEMENT : Un patron de travaux sur cordes poursuivi pour discrimination syndicale
content:
Jeudi 1er octobre 2026, NORD ACCESS sera jugée par le conseil des prud'hommes de Martigues (13). Après y avoir travaillé durant plusieurs années en tant que cordiste, Grégory poursuit l'entreprise pour discrimination en lien avec son activité syndicale.


En septembre 2024 et faisant suite à une enquête menée sur les conditions de travail dans l'entreprise, il participe avec l'association Cordistes en colère cordistes solidaires à adresser un long courrier d'alerte à NORD ACCESS. Suite à cela, on cesse immédiatement de lui proposer du travail, et ses nouvelles candidatures sont systématiquement toutes rejetées. On lui confirme alors que la direction a formellement interdit à toutes ses agences de le faire travailler dans l'entreprise.


Spécialisée dans les interventions sur cordes en milieu industriel, la société NORD ACCESS intervient partout en France. Depuis 2019, Grégory travaille régulièrement pour son agence basée dans le bassin de Fos-sur-Mer. Il y alterne les missions intérim et CDD. Au cours des années, il y effectue divers et nombreux chantiers avec d'autres collègues. Les plus fréquents consistent à réaliser des travaux en espaces confinés tels que la purge de fours d'incinération ou d'installations de cimenterie, la vidange de silos, etc. Mais aussi bien d'autres travaux de maintenance industrielle tels que la peinture, l'inspection, le nettoyage, des changements de pièces, l'étanchéité de toitures, etc. Au fil des années, la société NORD ACCESS fait intervenir Grégory dans de nombreux sites industriels du bassin de Fos-sur-Mer, mais également dans beaucoup d'autres, répartis dans les régions alentour : PACA, Occitanie, Rhône-Alpes.


Ses responsables directs se disent très satisfaits de son travail et n'hésitent pas à le solliciter régulièrement pour de nouveaux chantiers.


Pourtant, dès sa première mission d'intérim effectuée en mai 2019, la direction de NORD ACCESS n'était pas du même avis. Répondant à l'agence d'intérim de Grégory afin de clôturer un échange de mails relatifs à des heures non payées alors que bel et bien notées sur son relevé d'heures, le service des ressources humaines de NORD ACCESS écrivait : « Mettez lui ce qu'il souhaite, nous ne pouvons pas nous permettre de perdre du temps sur ce sujet. Par contre, nous ne pourrons plus reprendre [Grégory] au sein de notre structure. »


Le ton était donné.


Malgré cela, les responsables directs de Grégory, au niveau de l'agence sud de NORD ACCESS, préfèrent continuer de le faire travailler.


La direction n'insiste pas.


Grégory y trouve son compte, notamment du fait de la forte cohésion et de la bonne ambiance avec ses collègues de travail.


Début janvier 2024, Grégory est sollicité par l'entreprise pour une nouvelle série de contrats d'intérim successifs. De nouveau, son responsable se montre enthousiaste à l'idée de ce recrutement. Il écrit par mail : « Sans hésiter, je te compte dans mon effectif dès le début d'année. »


S'exprimer sur ses conditions de travail et alerter


Fin juin, et à l'occasion du championnat de France des cordistes à Marseille, l'association Cordistes en colère cordistes solidaires diffuse un texte écrit par plusieurs cordistes où ils dénoncent leurs conditions de travail au sein de la société NORD ACCESS.


À la demande de la société, l'association le retire peu de temps après de son site internet, car n'ayant pas elle même directement enquêté sur les faits évoqués. Dans un même temps, l'association indique toutefois à la société NORD ACCESS qu'elle est fréquemment sollicitée par plusieurs de ses salariés qui se sentent déconsidérés et exposés à des problèmes de sécurité. Une enquête sur les conditions de travail au sein de cette société, ainsi que des autres sociétés du groupe NA est alors lancée par l'association, début août 2024 : Lire ici l'article annonçant le lancement de l'enquête.


Il est convenu avec le PDG du groupe NA qu'une réunion se tiendra début septembre pour échanger avec l'association sur la base des résultats de son enquête.


Grégory se charge lui-même de ces échanges, étant impliqué de longue date au sein de l'association et du syndicat des cordistes.


Le 3 septembre, l'association adresse à la société un courrier de huit pages où sont listés point par point les problèmes évoqués par des salariés du groupe NA au cours de l'enquête. • Certaines rares appli ne fonctionne pas bien sur GOS, ça peut être le cas de certaines applis de banques, regardent ici ci la tienne est concerné. [4]


Normalement tu peux aussi consulter ta banque en allant sur un navigateur de recherche sans passer par les applis (c'est d'ailleurs recommandé d'utiliser au maximum le navigateur plutôt que les appli des services que tu consultes car il y a généralement des pisteurs publicitaire et autres merde dans les appli que tu télécharge).


• GOS est de base sans les services google et sans la playstore mais tu peux la réinstaller facilement (cf la brochure) si besoin


• Chacun.e à une utilisation différente de son téléphone, encore plus sur GrapheneOS, le but n'est pas d'avoir la « meilleur » utilisation, demande conseils autour de toi et adapte en fonction de ta situation, garde en tête que même avec GOS tu n'est pas en sécurité à 100 % car l'utilisation d'un téléphone en lui même induit des risques (comme le bornage du téléphone).


• Il existe aussi d'autres systèmes d'exploitations alternatifs comme LineageOS et eOS mais on les recommande moins car il sont moins résistant en terme de sécurité.[5]

author: syndicalist
title: Barry Pateman 1951-2026
content:
Sad to report on the sudden and untimely death of Barry Pateman: anarchist, militant, Kate Sharpley archivist, writer, publisher historian and teacher.

Please find short statement from the out Kate Sharpley Library announcing his death.

"Our comrade Barry Pateman died in hospital on Tuesday 22 September 2026 after a short illness. Barry supported many other projects from the Anarchist Black Cross to the Alexander Berkman Social Club but he was at the heart of the Kate Sharpley Library for 35 years. He described himself as an ‘awkward pupil’ of anarchist history but he helped to keep it alive and made it accessible to people from new generations. We are already missing him. A longer tribute will follow. We send love to his friends, family and comrades."

author: Unknown
title: « J'ai voulu en finir » - Lettre d'un prisonnier de Moulins-Yzeure
content:
M.C. Moulins-Yzeure 2026


Ce soir je prend mon stylo car je me sens prêt à vous raconter la soirée où j'ai voulu me « pendre »… Depuis quelques temps, la pénitentiaire s'acharne sur moi. Ils m'interdisent la douche l'après-midi, ils ne veulent pas me sortir de la « gestion individuelle ». Ils me refusent des permis de visite et me poussent à l'extrême… Le suicide est mal vu chez les détenu(e)s, c'est un signe de faiblesse… Un soir, après une journée bien chargée en embrouille avec les matons, j'ai pris un drap et j'ai préparé un noeud coulant… J'ai passé la journée à me défoncer au schitt pour ne pas avoir trop de réaction de survie… J'ai accroché le nœud coulant au plafond, je me suis posé et roulé un gros cône. Je regardais la corde pendre. J'en avais tellement marre de l'acharnement de l'A.P.* que j'ai pensé que le seul moyen d'arrêter toute cette merde c'est de me foutre en l'air… J'ai fumé à mort, fais un café, mis du son, bouché mon œilleton puis je suis monté sur la chaise et passé la corde autour du cou… J'ai fini mon cône puis j'ai fait tombé la chaise… Je suis facilement resté suspendu 2 minutes. Je vous avoue que le schitt n'a plus fait effet et la peur et les regrets ont pris le dessus… Quand le drap a lâché je suis tombé au sol et j'ai chialé, chialé parce que je me suis rendu compte que l'A.P. a failli m'avoir et j'aurais fait souffrir mes proches !! Maintenant je peux vous assurer que je ne ferai plus de tentative de suicide...


Mon geste n'était pas une faiblesse, juste un ras-le-bol !!! Plus d'une décennie que je suis incarcéré sans être passé aux assises… Remarques + que racistes et patriarcales, accès + que limité aux douches, tellement, que je me lave en cellule dans un seau !!! Palpé à chaque sortie de ma cellule, même pour prendre le repas et menotté pour aller l'infirmerie !!! Tout est fait pour que je me sens plus bas que terre… Mes journées en détention sont humiliantes, ils ne peuvent même pas ouvrir ma cellule si ils ne sont pas 3 matons + 1 gradé !!! Je ne suis plus un humain, je suis une bête, une chose, que l'on baillonne et menotte… Mes proches sont la pour moi, leur soutien est vital, leur amour et amitié pour moi me donne la force de continuer à tenir et le courage pour parler de cette soirée sombre… Il faut que ce sujet sorte de l'ombre, si un être humain se fout en l'air en prison c'est forcément que quelque-chose ne va pas !!! On a été privé de liberté. On nous a pas condamné à être torturé et à perdre notre dignité et humanité !!!! J'avais 22 ans quand je suis entré en prison, j'avais encore des rêves, je rigolais tout les jours. Aujourd'hui j'ai 37 ans, je ne suis toujours pas sorti de prison et mes rêves se sont envolés. J'ai une haine incroyable contre ce système archaïque et je ne rigole plus tous les jours… A chaque journée qui commence, je me demande quelle dinguerie ils me réservent… Le seul moment où je me sens un peu tranquille, c'est la nuit. Les matons peuvent pas ouvrir la porte sauf en cas d'urgence donc j'ai un semblant de tranquillité…


Voilà, à toutes et tous, sachez que même si la vie est dure, elle mérite que l'on se batte pour elle…


Je remercie mes proches pour leur soutien,


Merci à vous, je vous aime et vous dis à bientôt dehors…


Y'a pas d'arrangement !!


ON LACHE RIEN


ACAB


1312


Gilgenmann Mickaël


KEMI


*Administration Pénitentiaire

title: Intelectuales respaldan el rechazo a la participación de Ariana Harwicz y cuestionan la campaña de victimización
content:
Más de 500 escritoras, escritores, académicas, artistas, periodistas y trabajadores de la cultura de distintos países respaldaron a Rita Laura Segato, Lina Meruane, Sabina Urraca, Gabriela Wiener, María Fernanda Ampuero, Brenda Navarro, Silvia Federici y Ángelo Néstore, tras su posicionamiento contra la participación de Ariana Harwicz en el Festival CULTUR_ALH de Granada con respecto a una medida mundial de 

boicot pacìfico para denunciar el genocidio en Gaza. El comunicado rechaza que la discusión sea presentada como un ataque a una escritora por ser judía y sostiene que el cuestionamiento se vincula con posiciones que consideran negacionistas o justificatorias de la violencia contra el pueblo palestino. «Organizar un boicot pacífico no es censurar (…) La discusión es si nuestras instituciones culturales tienen la obligación de proporcionar escenarios, recursos, prestigio y legitimidad a cualquier posición política imaginable. Creemos que no: criticar no es censurar, protestar no es censurar». Por el contrario, la censura desde el lado del sionismo ha sido notoria. Por ANRed.


La controversia en torno a la participación de Ariana Harwicz en el Festival Internacional de Arte, Literatura y Humanidades CULTUR_ALH de Granada sumó una nueva dimensión: cientos de intelectuales, escritoras, artistas, docentes, periodistas y trabajadores de la cultura salieron públicamente a respaldar a quienes habían cuestionado su participación.


El comunicado reúne más de 500 firmas de referentes y trabajadores del campo cultural de Argentina, Chile, México, Colombia, Perú, España, Uruguay, Brasil y otros países. Entre quienes adhieren aparecen escritoras y escritores como Cristina Rivera Garza, Camila Sosa Villada, Lucrecia Martel, Alejandro Zambra, Mónica Ojeda, Isaac Rosa y Paul B. Preciado; además de académicas, periodistas, artistas y trabajadores de la cultura.


El respaldo está dirigido explícitamente a

Rita Laura Segato, Lina Meruane, Sabina Urraca, Gabriela Wiener, María Fernanda Ampuero, Brenda Navarro, Silvia Federici y Ángelo Néstore

, quienes habían expresado públicamente su posición ante la invitación de Harwicz. También reconoce el papel de la

Red Universitaria por Palestina de Granada

, cuya protesta antecedió a la decisión de la dirección del festival.


«Respaldamos también a la Red Universitaria por Palestina de Granada, cuya protesta y posicionamiento antecedieron a la decisión de la dirección del festival», señala el documento.


De esta manera, quienes firman buscan dejar en claro que no se trata de un pronunciamiento aislado de algunas figuras de la literatura, sino de una toma de posición colectiva dentro del campo cultural frente a los discursos y decisiones institucionales relacionados con Palestina.


El eje: Palestina, no la identidad


Uno de los principales puntos que plantea el comunicado es la necesidad de

correr el eje de la discusión

. Frente a la cobertura de medios que presentó la controversia en términos identitarios y a la acusación de antisemitismo contra quienes cuestionaron a Harwicz, las y los firmantes sostienen que el motivo de la protesta no es su condición de judía.


«Nos resistimos a que el debate quede reducido a un conflicto identitario y a que cualquier defensa a favor del pueblo palestino sea convertida automáticamente en antisemitismo», afirma el comunicado.


Y agrega: «Estamos contra el genocidio, contra la violencia ejercida sobre Palestina y contra los discursos que la niegan, la minimizan, la justifican o la celebran».


La declaración insiste en separar la crítica política al Estado de Israel y al sionismo del antisemitismo: «Las personas judías no constituyen un bloque político homogéneo y no responsabilizamos colectivamente a ninguna de ellas por las acciones del Estado de Israel».


También sostiene: «Criticar el sionismo no equivale a atacar a las personas judías ni a todas las israelíes» y «defender al pueblo palestino no equivale a atacar a las personas judías».


Así, el comunicado intenta disputar la interpretación que coloca la identidad de Harwicz en el centro de la controversia. Para las personas firmantes,

el eje es político: qué discursos son legitimados por las instituciones culturales y cuáles son cuestionados cuando se trata de la violencia contra el pueblo palestino

.


Una discusión que viene de antes: cuando hablar de Gaza tenia mas consecuencias

author: Publicación Abierta
title: La CIA y la oposición sondean cómo convertir a Venezuela en una república bananera
content:
El 26 de septiembre de 2026 sucedió en Venezuela algo que, contado con sencillez, vale más que mil informes de think tanks pagados por el Departamento de Estado. Una «encuestadora» —de la oposición, de la CIA, qué más da, el amo es el mismo— llegó a una casa a pedir permiso para hacer unas preguntas. La señora, con esa amabilidad que ni el bloqueo ni el odio mediático han conseguido arrancarle al pueblo venezolano, la dejó pasar.


Una encuesta que no salió como esperaban.


Le preguntaron qué le parecería María Corina Machado como presidenta. La señora respondió sin titubear que jamás votaría por esa bestia, por esa traidora vendepatrias, por esa alimaña ni por ninguno de sus secuaces. Le dieron entonces más nombres: Leopoldo López, Guaidó. Y ahí sí que se le acabó la paciencia: ninguno de esos ladrones y vendidos, dijo, le sirve para nada. La encuestadora, incómoda, intentó suavizar: «No se ponga así, alguno habrá». Pero la señora no es ninguna ignorante que se deje convencer con un tono condescendiente. Su respuesta fue un mazazo de claridad política: que no vuelvan, que se queden donde están o se vayan al infierno.


Esa anécdota, camaradas, vale más que todas las encuestas amañadas que publican los medios de la derecha para fabricar un «clamor popular» que no existe. El pueblo venezolano sabe perfectamente quién le ha hecho daño y quién no.


La mentira repetida mil veces.


Decir la verdad es siempre un acto revolucionario. Y hoy, cuando la mentira se ha convertido en un arma de las élites y en una herramienta de control de masas, repetida las veinticuatro horas desde los medios de desinformación y unas redes sociales en manos de la ultraderecha y el sionismo internacional, decir la verdad exige además valentía. La libertad de expresión en Occidente es otra farsa: como mucho, libertad de patalear sin molestar demasiado a quien manda.


Utilizan a diario la vieja receta de Goebbels, ministro de Propaganda del nazismo: una mentira repetida mil veces se convierte en verdad. Con Palestina, con Cuba, con Ucrania, con Rusia, con China, con Venezuela, llevan décadas aplicando esa táctica, deformando la realidad y prostituyendo la historia hasta hacerla irreconocible.


La democracia bolivariana frente a la democracia de los votos vacíos.


Hugo Chávez siempre habló de democracia protagónica, una democracia que va mucho más allá de votar cada cinco años, unida a la necesidad de una unión cívico-militar con base socialista y bolivariana. El socialismo de la República Bolivariana nunca pretendió copiar ninguna experiencia ajena: desde el principio, el legado del Libertador Simón Bolívar formó parte de la columna vertebral del proyecto liderado por Chávez.


En ningún país del mundo se ha votado más veces que en Venezuela. Desde la victoria electoral de 1998, el pueblo venezolano ha vuelto a las urnas una y otra vez, y se han construido las herramientas para que sean los propios venezolanos, y no los oligarcas ni la embajada de EE. UU. en Caracas, los dueños de su destino. Democracia protagónica significa que decide el pueblo, que las elecciones no son un cheque en blanco que se firma cada cierto tiempo para que decidan otros. Chávez recorrió el país entero defendiendo una nueva constituyente que pusiera esa herramienta también en manos populares.


Eso obligaba a romper con la democracia de partidos que funciona sin pueblo y solo con votos, la democracia burguesa que hace creer que se decide cuando, en realidad, solo se elige a quién delegarle el poder de decisión. En esa democracia burguesa mandan quienes son dueños de los partidos, ganan siempre los mismos y gobiernan poderes económicos a los que nadie ha elegido. Ahí está, como muestra actual, la figura de Elon Musk en la Casa Blanca: a él no lo votó nadie y, sin embargo, manda como el número dos de Trump. O como su jefe, que eso ya no queda tan claro.


El secuestro que en Occidente llaman operación.


La supuesta democracia norteamericana se permite dar lecciones a Venezuela mientras sostiene a una oposición que defiende los intereses de la oligarquía y de Washington, quienes la financian y deciden por ella sin contar jamás con el pueblo. Mentira, bulo, injerencia, sabotaje, llamamiento al golpe de Estado, amenaza de intervención militar, sanción, bloqueo: todo el arsenal se puso al servicio de tumbar la Revolución Bolivariana. Y, al final, el imperialismo cruzó la última línea roja.

title: BAB2026 – ΣΚΟΠΙΑ: Συλλογική απελευθέρωση με συλλογικές δράσεις υπέρβασης των διαχωριστικών και εκμεταλλευτικών πολιτικών, με συμμετοχή στις τοπικές κοινωνίες και ανάπτυξη αυτόνομων κοινωνικών δομών
content:
Ανταπόκριση infolibre


2η μέρα του 18ου Βαλκανικού Φεστιβάλ Βιβλίου, που διεξάγεται στην πρωτεύουσα της Βόρειας Μακεδονίας 24-27/9, με πλήθος εκδηλώσεων και συζητήσεων σε εύρος κοινωνικών θεμάτων αντίστασης, δράσης και επεξεργασίας εναλλακτικών σε κράτος, κυβερνήσεις και καπιταλισμό. Οι εκδηλώσεις του ΒΑΒ περιλάμβαναν την θεματολογία: Πως τα Βαλκάνια παρακολουθούνται – επιτηρούνται, κοινωνική οικολογία: από τον Μπούκτσιν στη Ροζάβα και πέραν, αντιστάσεις στην αποικιοκρατία στα Βαλκάνια, διατροφική ασφάλεια και κυριαρχία, τα Βαλκάνια αποθήκη των αποβλήτων, οικοδόμηση αμοιβαίας φροντίδα.


Στην εκδήλωση για: Πως τα Βαλκάνια παρακολουθούνται – επιτηρούνται, παρουσιάστηκε το πώς η νέα τεχνολογία έχει αναπτύξει εργαλεία παρακολούθησης, τα οποία χρησιμοποιούνται από τα κράτη και τις κυβερνήσεις για τη δίωξη αγωνιζόμενων. Αναλύθηκε το νομικό οπλοστάσιο νομιμοποίησης τέτοιων μεθόδων, όπως και η αξιοποίηση των social media. Επιδίωξή τους είναι η εκκαθάριση των εστιών αντίστασης και η προώθηση των διαχωριστικών πολιτικών της εξουσίας, της εκμετάλλευσης, της στρατιωτικοποίησης, του gentrification κ.α. Γι αυτό ως κίνημα πρέπει να δούμε πως θα απαλλαγούμε από μία τέτοια κατάσταση, όχι μόνο ατομικά αλλά και συλλογικά.


Εφαρμόζοντας την κοινωνική οικολογία: από τον Μπούκτσιν στη Ροζάβα και πέραν, ήταν μία άλλη παρουσίαση, με σχετικά παραδείγματα. Ζούμε διαιρεμένοι και αποξενωμένοι, γι αυτό πρέπει να δούμε τις θέσεις μας, τις αντιθέσεις και τις συνθέσεις στο κοινωνικό περιβάλλον που ζούμε. Με συλλογική δράση και ταξική πάλη για τη συλλογική απελευθέρωση για μια ελεύθερη ζωή. Τα όποια παραδείγματα, όπως της Ροζάβα και του Μπακούρ πρέπει να μεταλαμπαδευτούν.


Στις αντιστάσεις στην αποικιοκρατία στα Βαλκάνια, έγινε αναφορά σε μία άλλη εκδήλωση, όπου τονίστηκε η αναγκαιότητα υπέρβασης των εμποδίων της ιστορίας και του παρελθόντος της. Να σπάσουμε το εθνικό υπόβαθρο που εμποδίζει τις κοινωνίες αλλά και το κίνημα, να υπερβούμε τους εθνικούς διαχωρισμούς.


Ενδιαφέρουσα παρουσίαση – συζήτηση έγινε σχετικά με τη: διατροφική ασφάλεια και κυριαρχία, τονίζοντας την ανάγκη της αυτονομίας σε αυτό το κοινωνικό πεδίο. Στις αντιστάσεις στα διάφορα μεγα-σχέδια στα Βαλκάνια, τις ενεργειακές υποδομές, τον εξορυκτισμό, αναφέρθηκαν οι ομιλητές από διάφορες βαλκανικές περιοχές μεταφέροντας τις εμπειρίες τους. Όπως τόνισαν, δεν πρέπει να βλέπουμε την παρέμβασή μας απλά στη μεταφορά του λόγου του κινήματος στις τοπικές κοινωνίες που αγωνίζονται για περιβαλλοντικά ζητήματα, αλλά με τη ζύμωση και επεξεργασία στα τοπικά μετωπικά σχήματα.


Παραπλήσιοι προβληματισμοί κατατέθηκαν στην εκδήλωση για: τα Βαλκάνια αποθήκη των αποβλήτων, αναφέροντας ότι το σύστημα αξιοποιεί τη λεγόμενη πράσινη ανάπτυξη. Καταστρέφει το περιβάλλον και γι αυτό αρκετοί στις τοπικές κοινωνίες βγαίνουν και διαμαρτύρονται. Το ζήτημα είναι η απεύθυνσή μας σε αυτές, όχι με όρους λόγου και δράσης κάποιων αναρχικών από τις πόλεις, αλλά συμμετοχής σε αυτές και κατεύθυνση ενάντια στο περιβαλλοντικό ιμπεριαλισμό.


Η οικοδόμηση αμοιβαίας φροντίδας, ιδιαίτερα στα θύματα του κοινωνικού αποκλεισμού, διατυπώθηκε σε σχετικό εργαστήρι, αναφέροντας παραδείγματα από περιπτώσεις έμφυλης βίας και τονίζοντας την ανάγκη ανάπτυξης κοινοτήτων διαχείρισης τέτοιων καταστάσεων.


Όπως κάθε βράδυ, το ΒΑΒ ολοκληρώνεται με συναυλίες σε τρία διαφορετικά μέρη στην πόλη των Σκοπίων, με βασικό το στέκι Dunya.

content:
It’s time again for the weekly news quiz. What do you remember from this week’s headlines? Let’s go!


1.

 Udlu Hanson, Baffinland’s vice-president

of community and strategic development,

has been named to a prestigious list. What is it?


A.

 She has been named one of the top 10 most business-savvy northerners of 2026.


B.

 She’s one of Canada’s 104 most powerful women.


C.

 She’

s in the top 3 most impactful people in the world to hold that specific executive role.


2.

 Filmmaker Zacharias Kunuk has been honoured with a Governor General’s artistic achievement award. Twenty-five years ago he released

Atanarjuat: The Fast Runner

, which went on to be acclaimed as one of Canada’s best films of all time. What is he working on now?


A.

 A sequel to

Atanarjuat: The Fast Runner

called

 Atanarjuat 2: Running Faster

.


B.

 A documentary about Tallurutiup Imanga National Marine Conservation Area, and all the animals that thrive there.


C.

 An eight-part documentary series covering Inuit history, called

Qirngaqtuq — Fierce Prayer.


3.

 The Kivalliq Trade show ran Monday to Wednesday in Rankin Inlet. What was the theme?


A.

 Listen!


B.

 Big money!


C.

 You’re hired!


4.

 Speaking of trade shows, last week’s Nunavut Trade Show in Iqaluit ended with a gala celebrating the best and brightest of Baffin’s business community. Who won Business Person of the Year?


A.

 Kirt Ejesiak, owner of Sedna ROV Services


B.

 Glenn Cousins, of Kakivak Association


C.

 The late Rhoda Cunningham, who started Innirvik Support Services


5.

 Naujaat is celebrating a clean energy milestone with the completion of a $19-million solar project in the hamlet. Why did the

former Kivalliq Inuit Association director Helena Malliki push for solar panels in Naujaat?


A.

 Naujaat is located in a region that gets very little cloud cover.


B.

 Malliki is a self-described solar evangelist after installing panels on her own home.


C.

 Naujaat and Coral Harbour are not included in a proposal to connect several Kivalliq communities to the southern power grid through the Kivalliq Hydro-Fibre Link. So Malliki felt Naujaat needed an option to reduce the hamlet’s reliance on diesel.


Community leaders, government officials and project partners gather in Naujaat to mark the completion of a $19-million solar and battery-storage project that’s expected to supply about 30 per cent of the community’s annual electricity needs. Pictured here, from left to right, is Ernest Douglas, QEC president and CEO; Gwen Healey Akearok, minister responsible for QEC; Alex Guilbeault, QEC’s vice president of operations and engineering; Otito Atansi, QEC’s manager of alternative and renewable energy; Stephan Angotialuk, QEC’s assistant operator in Naujaat; and Jonathan Siusangnark, QEC’s plant superintendent in Naujaat. (Photo courtesy of Qulliq Energy Corp.)


Answers:


1.

 B — Udlu Hanson is

named among

 the Women’s Executive Network’s 104 most powerful women in Canada. She is the first Inuk from Nunavut to receive the honour since 2010. Hanson said she’s proud to be on the list. She also said there are so many strong Inuit women that she believes they should have their own list.


2.

 C — Zacharias Kunuk’s

current project

 is called

Qirngaqtuq — Fierce Prayer. 

It’s an eight-part documentary that starts with Inuit life pre-contact and covers the arrival of whalers and Anglican missionaries.


3.

 A — The

theme

 for the 2026 Kivalliq Trade Show was Naalagit, or Listen. It was broken out into three separate challenges to business leaders — listen to communities, to youth and to business.


4.

 A —

Business Person of the Year

 at this year’s Nunavut Trade Show was Kirt Ejesiak, owner of Sedna ROV Services. He recently received federal funding for underwater drones that generate images of the seabed around Nunavut.


5.

 C — Naujaat is

not included

 in a proposed project to connect five Kivalliq communities —

Arviat, Baker Lake, Chesterfield Inlet, Rankin Inlet and Whale Cove — to Manitoba’s power grid. “I was asking if we can get a windmill or a solar panel, and I fought for that,” Malliki said. “And it happened.”

author: Corey Larocque
title: Emphasis on listening should be Kivalliq Trade Show’s export across the North
content:
There was a lot of talk about listening in Rankin Inlet this week.


Naalagit — or Listen, in English — was the theme of the Kivalliq Trade Show.


It was impressive to see how closely the speakers embraced that simple theme in their speeches.


Political and business leaders such as Sen. Nancy Karetak-Lindell, Nunavut Tunngavik Inc. president Gloria Uluqsi, Kivalliq Inuit Association president Koonoo Tattuinee, and Agnico Eagle Meliadine Mine general manager Marc-Olivier Vachon all tailored their speeches to include what it means to listen.


Karetak-Lindell told delegates Wednesday that listening to communities, youth and businesses can give us all a better understanding of their goals and aspirations. Communication must go both ways — speaking and listening — to make conversations productive and to lead to action, she said.


There was also a lot of trade show talk about how much the Arctic is changing. People have questions and concerns about Arctic security, defence construction, massive projects like the Kivalliq Hydro-Fibre Link, housing and climate change.


The faster things change, the more important it becomes to listen to ideas about both the benefits and challenges of those changes.


“In order for leaders, governments at all levels, and the public to listen, there has to be people, groups, businesses, and communities speaking up, briefly and purposefully offering wisdom and direction,” Karetak-Lindell said.


The importance of listening should go without saying. But sometimes it doesn’t hurt to be reminded of the things we know to be true.


At the risk of sounding self-serving, Nunatsiaq News is also here to listen. Journalists listen on behalf of their readers, and then tell them what they heard.


Journalists listen to the legislative assembly, at the courthouse, to business leaders, as well as to regular people talking about what’s going on in their daily lives.


They do a lot of listening — to hours of the legislative assembly, for example — so you don’t have to.


Unfortunately, many organizations in Nunavut and Nunavik — governments, Inuit organizations, police, businesses — aren’t always that crazy about talking. Especially to reporters.


Perhaps things are changing. It was encouraging to hear NTI president

Gloria Uluqsi

 tell trade show delegates, “An informed Inuk is much harder to leave out of a decision that affects them.”


When it comes to making sure that Inuit — and all readers — are informed, a newspaper can be part of the equation.


Coincidentally the message about listening landed just ahead of the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation on Sept. 30. When it became a holiday five years ago, the idea was for it to be time to reflect on harm done by Canada’s residential school system. For a lot of Canadians, it’s a time for listening.


We all want to see the benefits that come from listening — the benefits that speaker after speaker in Rankin Inlet talked about.


The Kivalliq Trade Show was largely a business conference, intended as a place for company representatives to network and make deals.


But after the emphasis on the theme Naalagit — Listen — the spirit of listening should be a byproduct of that business event that could be exported beyond Rankin Inlet to the entire Arctic.

El fascismo del fin de los tiempos: hacer negocio hasta que llegue el apocalipsis


Por Naomi Klein Y Astra Taylor 


24 Septiembre, 2026


El mundo asiste a la emergencia de un nuevo fascismo. La gran diferencia con la pesadilla que vivimos en el siglo XX es que los monstruos de aquellos tiempos engañaban a las masas con la promesa de un futuro purificado, rico y estable mientras los de ahora aceleran sin frenos hacia la catástrofe al grito de sálvese quien tenga dinero. La alianza de etnonacionalistas, tecnoligarcas y fanáticos religiosos ha dado la espalda a un porvenir común


Este verano, a medida que el calor implacable y la sequía hacían bajar sus niveles de agua, el Danubio empezó a mostrar sus secretos. Como si fueran monstruos que surgían del fango del tiempo, empezaron a aparecer restos hundidos de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.


En Serbia, el río, al secarse, dejó al descubierto al menos 20 barcos nazis, algunos de ellos aún cargados de munición sin detonar. En Hungría, dejó al aire una motocicleta militar nazi cubierta de barro caliente, cerca de las medallas y las placas de identificación oxidadas de dos soldados alemanes. En Eslovaquia, un transeúnte vio que asomaba en el río casi desaparecido una enorme bomba de 680 kilos plantada por la Royal Air Force. Las autoridades tuvieron que transportar con cuidado el arma, que llevaba más de 80 años sumergida, y detonarla bajo tierra, a gran profundidad.


Muchos observadores tienen la sensación de que estas apariciones fantasmales y amenazadoras del pasado de Europa son, más que una curiosidad histórica, una metáfora demasiado literal: la forma que tiene la naturaleza de confirmar la frase de William Faulkner de que “el pasado nunca muere. Ni siquiera es pasado”.


La impresión de que la historia se repite se apoya en muchos datos. A lo largo de todo el Danubio, en la última década ha habido un auge de la nostalgia por una época en la que la “civilización europea” dominaba de forma absoluta, y cada nueva oleada de extrema derecha coquetea con más descaro que la anterior con políticas y consignas raciales que se suponía que habían quedado enterradas al desaparecer el Tercer Reich.


La magnitud de este renacimiento quedó patente a principios de 2025 en la Conferencia de Seguridad de Múnich. Allí, el vicepresidente de Estados Unidos, J. D. Vance, recién investido, reprendió a los líderes europeos por mantener un cortafuegos político que aislaba a partidos de extrema derecha antes intocables.


Además, se desvivió por reunirse con el partido alemán Alternativa por Alemania (AfD), que ha difundido propuestas para la “remigración” de grandes cantidades de gente y cuyo antiguo colíder llegó a decir que la época nazi no era más que una “caca de pájaro” en la historia del país. Este septiembre, el partido logró un avance electoral histórico en Sajonia-Anhalt, al obtener un 43,8 por ciento de los votos.


Más al este, a orillas del Danubio, el Partido de la Libertad de Austria (FPÖ), fundado en 1956 por un antiguo funcionario nazi, goza de la mayor popularidad de su historia y Walter Rosenkranz, miembro destacado del partido, ocupa el segundo cargo más importante del país. El año pasado, el jefe de gabinete de Rosenkranz tuvo que dimitir cuando se supo que una investigación oficial sobre los “Separatistas Sajones”, de extrema derecha, había descubierto un alijo de munición y parafernalia nazi en una propiedad vinculada a él, aunque él negó vivir allí.


Da la casualidad de que el grupo que está en el centro de la polémica tiene las iniciales “SS”, como da la casualidad de que Elon Musk, acérrimo partidario de la AfD y de otros grupos de la extrema derecha europea, expresó su gratitud a los votantes de Trump en enero de 2025 con un gesto que muchos interpretaron como un saludo nazi. (Musk restó importancia a la crítica y publicó en su plataforma X: “Francamente, necesitan mejores artimañas. La crítica de que ‘todo el mundo es Hitler’ está muuuuy manida”).


Igual que los buques de guerra hundidos que están saliendo a la luz a medida que baja el nivel del Danubio, el fascismo parece estar resurgiendo en Europa, Estados Unidos y otros países. Sin embargo, después de haber acabado de escribir un libro sobre los rasgos distintivos del fascismo contemporáneo, no acaban de gustarnos las comparaciones históricas lineales. author: Lubio Lenin Cardozo
title: Solarismus als Vorschlag für das Werden der Menschheit
content:
Der Solarismus ist ein Denkangebot, um die Transformation der Menschheit in ihrem Übergang zu einer neuen energetischen und zivilisatorischen Ära zu interpretieren und zu begleiten. Er beschränkt sich nicht darauf, fossile Brennstoffe durch erneuerbare Energien zu ersetzen, und lässt sich nicht auf einen technologischen Vorschlag reduzieren.


Seine zentrale Frage ist viel größer: Welche Art von Menschheit kann entstehen, wenn sich die Art und Weise ändert, wie eine Gesellschaft Energie gewinnt, produziert, verteilt, verwaltet und nutzt?


Aus dieser Perspektive hört Energie auf, ausschließlich als technische oder ökonomische Ressource betrachtet zu werden. Sie wird als eine der materiellen Bedingungen verstanden, auf denen Autonomie, Macht, Bürgerschaft, Freiheit und menschliches Wohlergehen aufgebaut werden.


Der Solarismus geht von einer historischen Feststellung aus: Die großen Transformationen der Zivilisation waren eng mit energetischen Transformationen verbunden. Die Menschheit ging von der Beherrschung des Feuers zur Landwirtschaft, von der Kohle zur Industrialisierung und vom Erdöl zu einer Zivilisation von außergewöhnlicher Produktivität — aber auch von tiefer Abhängigkeit von konzentrierten und extraktiven Energiesystemen.


Deutschland weiß das sehr gut. Vom Ruhrgebiet bis zur Lausitz wurde eine ganze Kultur auf Kohle gebaut. Die Energiewende hat gezeigt, dass man Atome und Kohle abschalten kann. Aber sie hat auch gezeigt, dass eine technologische Substitution nicht automatisch eine Demokratisierung bedeutet.


Der Übergang zu erneuerbaren Quellen, insbesondere zur Sonnenenergie, eröffnet daher eine Möglichkeit, die über den technologischen Ersatz hinausgeht. Das grundlegende Merkmal der Sonnenenergie liegt nicht nur darin, dass sie erneuerbar ist, sondern darin, dass sie potenziell an Millionen von Orten und von einer Vielzahl von Akteuren gewonnen werden kann. Diese Bedingung ermöglicht es, neue Formen der Verteilung energetischer Kapazität zu denken.


Daraus entsteht eines der zentralen Prinzipien des Solarismus:


Die Geometrie der Energie kann die Geometrie der Macht transformieren.


Eine Gesellschaft, die die Gewinnung, das Eigentum und die Verwaltung von Energie konzentriert, kann zentralisierte Machtstrukturen reproduzieren — selbst wenn sie Solarpaneele aufstellt. Eine Gesellschaft, die diese Fähigkeiten verteilt, kann neue Möglichkeiten für Autonomie, Teilhabe und energetische Bürgerschaft eröffnen. Die technologische Verteilung garantiert jedoch nicht automatisch die Demokratisierung: Es wird auch notwendig sein zu fragen, wem die Infrastrukturen gehören, wer die digitalen Systeme kontrolliert, wer die Daten verwaltet und wer an den Entscheidungen teilnimmt.


Deshalb schlägt der Solarismus vor, über das Auftauchen eines Energetischen Subjekts nachzudenken: die Person, Familie, Organisation oder Gemeinschaft, die aufhört, ausschließlich Konsument zu sein, und die Fähigkeit erwirbt, einen Teil der Energie, die ihre Existenz trägt, zu gewinnen, zu produzieren, zu verwalten, zu teilen und darüber zu entscheiden.


Diese Transformation kann Konsequenzen haben, die weit über den Energiesektor hinausgehen. Wenn Energie dazu beiträgt, Zeit freizusetzen, wird die nächste Frage sein, was die Menschheit mit dieser Zeit macht. Wenn die Autonomie zunimmt, muss gefragt werden, wofür wir unsere Freiheit nutzen. Wenn die Produktivität steigt, muss gefragt werden, ob sich diese Produktivität in mehr Wohlbefinden oder einfach in mehr Konsum verwandelt.


So führt der Solarismus schrittweise von der Energie zur Autonomie; von der Autonomie zur Freiheit; von der Freiheit zur Zeit; von der Zeit zum Sinn; und vom Sinn zu einer grundlegenden Frage: Was bedeutet es, gut zu leben?


In diesem Sinne will der Solarismus nicht die Zukunft vorhersagen oder eine fertige Gesellschaft präsentieren. Er schlägt vor, eine Reflexion über die möglichen Wege des menschlichen Werdens zu eröffnen. Er behauptet nicht, dass Solarenergie automatisch die sozialen, ökonomischen oder ökologischen Widersprüche lösen wird. Er stellt vielmehr fest, dass eine Transformation der Energieinfrastruktur neue materielle Bedingungen schaffen kann, die die Menschheit mit institutionellen, kulturellen, ökonomischen und ethischen Transformationen begleiten muss.


Sein letzter Horizont ist die Möglichkeit einer Zivilisation, die in der Lage ist, eine größere energetische Verfügbarkeit nicht zu nutzen, um grenzenlos zu konsumieren, sondern um …

author: Unknown
title: Balance of power is shifting in Iraq
content:
The 12-year mission of the international coalition against ISIS in Iraq will officially end on 30 September. The date will also mark the end of the US military presence in the country that began with the 2003 invasion. Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has described the deadline as “fixed and final”, while Baghdad is also accelerating plans to bring weapons under exclusive state control. The question of what awaits Iraq once the withdrawal is complete is critical both for the country’s internal balance of power and the reshaping of regional dynamics.


What lies behind the withdrawal decision?


An agreement reached between Baghdad and Washington in 2024 provided for the phased conclusion of the international coalition’s mission against ISIS. Bases in central Iraq were evacuated in the first phase, while hundreds of troops and air defence systems remained around Erbil (Hewlêr) in Southern Kurdistan (Başur).


Ali al-Zaidi, who became prime minister in May 2026, travelled to Washington in July and met US President Donald Trump at the White House. Trump said during the meeting that the US military presence in Iraq was no longer necessary and indicated that the relationship would increasingly focus on companies and investment.


Talks between the Baghdad government and US Central Command (CENTCOM) subsequently clarified the timetable for the coalition forces’ withdrawal from Iraq. The final deadline for ending the coalition’s military mission was set for 30 September.


Troops to be redeployed to Jordan


The destination of the departing troops is being closely watched. Hundreds of US troops are expected to be redeployed to other countries in the region, while military equipment, including air defence systems, is also being withdrawn from Iraq. The remaining systems in the Kurdistan Region are due to be removed as part of the withdrawal.


Al-Zaidi’s close relationship with the Trump administration and commercial agreements with Washington have strengthened Baghdad’s emphasis on sovereignty. At the same time, US pressure over Iran-aligned armed groups has become an important factor in the Iraqi government’s efforts to consolidate state authority over weapons.


The withdrawal will also be a major test of Baghdad’s stated aim of establishing a post-coalition order based on the principle of no foreign troops and exclusive state control over weapons.


Disarmament process


The Zaidi government wants to pursue the withdrawal of coalition forces alongside its plan to bring weapons under exclusive state control. Based on the argument that “once foreign forces leave, there will be no justification for resistance”, the government initially set 30 September as the target date for both the withdrawal and the surrender of weapons. Some groups have taken steps towards compliance since the process was formally announced in June 2026, while others continue to oppose the plan.


Asaib Ahl al-Haq and Kataib Imam Ali have begun moving towards integration into the state security structure. The groups have opted for a process aimed at bringing their armed structures under state authority.


More hardline Iran-aligned groups, however, have refused to surrender their weapons. Kataib Hezbollah, Harakat al-Nujaba and Kataib Sayyid al-Shuhada are among those opposing disarmament. They have linked any move to give up their weapons to the complete withdrawal of foreign military forces and the removal of what they regard as regional threats. Their statements portray their weapons both as leverage within Iraq’s internal balance of power and as protection against external intervention.


New 90-day timetable


Baghdad has now turned 30 September from a final deadline into the starting point of a new process amid resistance from armed groups. Zaidi said an initial 90-day phase would begin under a revised plan, with the process of bringing weapons under state control targeted for completion by 30 June 2027.


Zaidi said the plan was not optional. Under the first phase, armed groups would refrain from carrying out attacks for 90 days, while US forces would not target them. The plan would then move towards the gradual handover of weapons.


The weapons are expected to be transferred through a new mechanism within the Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF), rather than directly to the central army. In this respect, the plan is aimed less at complete disarmament than at bringing armed structures under state control.
